body.name: \(\mathcal A_G(\mathcal O_G)\)
body.construction:
For \(T=(B^{(a)})_{a\in M}\), let \(\mathcal U(T)\) be the directed union-support graph on \(V\), with \(i\to j\) exactly when \(B^{(a)}[j,i]\ne0\) for at least one \(a\in M\).  Let \(\operatorname{TC}^{+}(\mathcal U(T))\) denote its strict transitive closure.  Whenever \(\Theta_G(\mathcal O_G)\ne\varnothing\), define the common union-support ancestry relation by
\[
 \mathcal A_G(\mathcal O_G)=
 \bigcap_{T\in\Theta_G(\mathcal O_G)}
 \operatorname{TC}^{+}(\mathcal U(T)).
\]
